agb.meta_beschreibung: Terms of use for the OneFam website, the waiting list and the member account.
agb.einleitung: These terms govern the use of this website, joining our waiting list and the OneFam member account. There is currently no prize draw, no raffle and no travel pool programme. Please read them carefully.

bloecke.text: The provider is:

These terms apply to the use of this website (waiting list, member account, community content). Orders in our online shop (shop.onefam.ch) are governed exclusively by the separate terms and conditions published there.

abschnitte.titel: What OneFam is – and what it currently is not

bloecke.text: OneFam is a clothing brand with its own online shop and a community for people who belong to more than one place. What matters to us is holding together and sharing values (see «The Family Code»).

Our long-term goal is to make shared travel possible one day. That is a statement of intent, not an offer: there is currently no travel pool programme, no allocation of travel places and no entitlement whatsoever to a trip or any other benefit. Statements about this goal on our website are non-binding and do not constitute any assurance.

punkte: Joining is free and does not require a purchase.
We collect your email address; giving a name is optional.
By joining you consent to receiving emails from us about OneFam.
You can withdraw that consent at any time and without giving reasons – via the unsubscribe link in every email or informally to info@onefam.ch.
Joining does not create membership, participation in any selection, or an entitlement to any benefit.

bloecke.text: We only send promotional emails to people who signed up themselves, and every message points out how to unsubscribe (Art. 3 para. 1 lit. o of the Swiss Unfair Competition Act).

For certain areas you can sign in with your email address; signing in works through a login link, without a password. You are responsible for protecting access to your email account. We may suspend or delete accounts if these terms are breached. There is no entitlement to the provision or the continued existence of an account.

abschnitte.titel: Possible future extra features for buyers

bloecke.text: In future we intend to offer people who have ordered from our shop additional features – such as a non-binding vote on a possible future destination and a world map. These features are not available at present. Should we offer them, they are a voluntary thank you with no monetary value. They create no entitlement to a trip, to the implementation of a voting result or to any other benefit, and we may change or discontinue them at any time.

abschnitte.titel: No competition, no raffle, no gambling

bloecke.text: This website currently runs no competition, no raffle and no gambling within the meaning of the Swiss Gambling Act (BGS). No stake is placed, no selection is carried out and no prize of monetary value is held out.
Should we introduce an allocation of travel places in future, it will happen exclusively on the basis of our own terms of participation, published in advance, and after a prior legal review.

Orders are concluded exclusively via shop.onefam.ch; the terms and conditions published there apply, including the rules on prices, shipping, withdrawal and warranty. A purchase grants no advantages beyond the extra features named in section 5.

You undertake to respect the values of the community («The Family Code»), to give accurate information and not to manipulate our services – in particular not through multiple or third-party sign-ups, entering other people's email addresses or automated access. In case of breaches we may remove entries and accounts.

abschnitte.titel: Availability and changes to the website

bloecke.text: We provide this website free of charge and do not owe any particular availability. We may change, restrict or discontinue content and features at any time.
All content on this website – in particular texts, images, graphics, logo and designs – is protected and may not be used outside ordinary private use without our prior written consent.

To the extent permitted by law, OneFam's liability for damages in connection with the use of this website is excluded. Excepted are damages caused by gross negligence or intent, as well as cases of mandatory statutory liability.
Information on how we handle your data – including the waiting list data – can be found in our <ds>privacy policy</ds>.
We may adjust these terms at any time. The version published at the time of use applies.

abschnitte.titel: Governing law and place of jurisdiction

bloecke.text: Swiss law applies exclusively. The exclusive place of jurisdiction is – to the extent permitted by law – the provider's registered office in Basel.

datenschutz.meta_beschreibung: How OneFam handles your data – privacy policy under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP).
datenschutz.einleitung: Protecting your data matters to us. This policy tells you which personal data we process when you visit this website and which rights you have. It follows the revised Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP).

bloecke.text: Responsible for processing personal data on this website is:

This policy applies to this website (onefam.ch). Our online shop at shop.onefam.ch runs on a separate platform and has its own privacy policy. Orders, customer accounts and payments in the shop are governed exclusively by the provisions published there.

Personal data is any information relating to an identified or identifiable person. We process data in accordance with the principles of good faith, proportionality and purpose limitation – and only as far as it is necessary to operate this website.
When you access this website, our hosting provider automatically collects data and stores it temporarily in what are known as server log files. This includes:

punkte: the IP address of the accessing device
the date and time of access
browser type and version as well as the operating system

bloecke.text: This data serves solely the technical operation, the security and the stability of the website and is not combined with other data sources.
The hosting provider is Vercel Inc., 340 S Lemon Ave #4133, Walnut, CA 91789, USA. Processing takes place partly on servers outside Switzerland (see section 10).

This website uses no analytics, tracking or advertising tools (e.g. Google Analytics, Meta Pixel or similar). No usage profiles are created and no data is passed on to third parties for advertising purposes.

We use strictly necessary cookies only: when you sign in, your browser stores a session cookie so that you stay logged in. Without this cookie signing in does not work. If you do not sign in, no cookies are set. Should we use further cookies in future, this policy will be adjusted and – where required – your consent obtained.

If you join our waiting list, we process your email address, a name if you choose to give one, and the time you signed up. The sole purpose is to keep you informed about OneFam. The basis is your consent.

You can unsubscribe at any time – via the unsubscribe link in every email or informally to info@onefam.ch. We then delete your entry. We do not pass this data on to third parties and do not use it to advertise other companies.

For signing in we process your email address as well as technical details about the session. Signing in works through a login link sent by email; we do not store a password. If you have ordered from our shop, we additionally store the information that an order exists, in order to unlock extra features for you.
Waiting list and account data are stored with Supabase (Zurich region, Switzerland). Emails are sent through a service provider that processes the addresses exclusively on our behalf.

If you contact us by email, phone or through a messenger service, the details you provide (e.g. name, contact details and the content of your message) are stored and used to handle your enquiry. We do not pass this data on without your consent and delete it as soon as it is no longer needed and no statutory retention obligations stand in the way.

On this website we link to external platforms and messenger services (including Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, Telegram, Threema). These links are plain references – simply opening our website transmits no data to those providers. Only when you click a link do you reach the respective platform, where their own data protection provisions apply and over whose data processing we have no influence. If you contact us through a messenger, your data is additionally processed via that provider's servers.

In the course of hosting and when using messenger and social media services, data may be transferred abroad – including to the USA. A transfer only takes place where an adequate level of data protection is ensured or suitable safeguards (e.g. standard contractual clauses) are in place, as the FADP requires.
We keep personal data only for as long as it is necessary for the respective purposes or as statutory retention periods require. After that the data is deleted or anonymised.
This website is delivered encrypted via HTTPS (TLS). We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss or misuse.
Under the applicable data protection law you have in particular the following rights:

punkte: information about the data processed about you
deletion or destruction of your data
restriction of processing and objection to processing
release or transfer of your data

bloecke.text: A message to the contact details given above is enough to exercise them. To handle your request we may have to verify your identity.

You have the right to complain to the competent supervisory authority. In Switzerland this is the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC), Feldeggweg 1, 3003 Bern (www.edoeb.admin.ch).
We may adjust this privacy policy at any time, for instance if the data processing or the legal situation changes. The version published on this website at the time applies.
